# authwise_guard_relay_pool_access (Resource)

Which estate relay pools a tenant's networks may use, beyond the estate default, and the tenant's default pool. Operators only.

One per tenant, and authoritative: pools left out of `allowed_pools` are not allowed. A network already on a pool an update removes keeps it, but a write that names it again is refused. `default_pool` is the **tenant** default: a network of the tenant created without `relay_pool` gets it, and it is allowed by being the default. Empty, the tenant takes the **estate** default, the pool whose `default` is set (`authwise_guard_relay_pool`).

Destroy writes the access empty: the tenant keeps the estate default only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Which pools a tenant may use beyond the estate default, and its own
# default pool. Operators only; authoritative.
resource "authwise_guard_relay_pool_access" "acme" {
  tenant_id     = "t-01" # the kit tenant Guard is on
  allowed_pools = [authwise_guard_relay_pool.eu_west.name]
  default_pool  = authwise_guard_relay_pool.eu_west.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The kit tenant's id (`t-…`) the Guard row belongs to. Guard has no tenant of its own since the tenant collapse (tf#65). The provider's `tenant_id` is not used. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `allowed_pools` (Set of String) Pools the tenant may use beyond the estate default: `authwise_guard_relay_pool.<name>.name` (`relay-pools/rp-…`). Empty when unset.
- `default_pool` (String) The tenant's default pool, `relay-pools/rp-…`. Empty (the default) means the estate default.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) `tenants/t-…/relay-pool-access`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the kit tenant's id.
terraform import authwise_guard_relay_pool_access.acme t-01
```
